findings.title: Fallback locale files are not loaded on translate
findings.body: The on-demand loader in translate only calls load_locale for I18n.config.locale, and load_translations was patched to never load other locale YAML files. FallbackLocaleList therefore only works when something has already called I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!, which this PR does solely from ApplicationController#set_locale. Mailers, Sidekiq/jobs, the console, and any I18n.with_locale / I18n.locale= path never load the site-default or English files, so a missing key in the active locale stays missing instead of falling back. Server-side fallbacks are broken for most non-request translation.

findings.title: Translation cache ignores dynamic fallback locale
findings.body: The accelerator cache key is only key + current locale + backend object id. Fallback resolution now depends on SiteSetting.default_locale, which can change at runtime without replacing the backend. After an admin changes the site default locale, cached hits keep the translation resolved through the old fallback chain (or a previously cached missing result) until that LRU entry is evicted, so users see the wrong language for keys that are not defined in their own locale.

findings.title: No tests for custom fallback chain or preload
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList and the ensure_loaded! hook are new behavior with no specs. Nothing checks the user-locale → site default → :en order, that fallback YAML is actually loaded before lookup, or that translations outside ApplicationController#set_locale still fall back. The loader/cache bugs above would not be caught before merge.
